title: Threshold-of-thresholds size bound
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the sign cube of dimension $n$ and a natural number $s$, the function has a threshold-of-thresholds representation of size at most $s$ if there is a natural number $t\le s$ such that $f$ is a threshold of thresholds of size $t$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
There exists a natural number $t\le s$ for which the function is a threshold of thresholds of size $t$
caveat: The underlying notion of a threshold of thresholds is not defined in the supplied context.
